entrypoints.description: Typed handoff checkpoint owns bounded current horizon/cursor reconstruction.

extension_seams: Add compact required bootstrap references when a new permanent governance mechanism must survive every handoff.
Add resume-relevant asset transport metadata without turning the handoff into a historical asset ledger.
Improve on-demand routing into cold Git/Issue/receipt history without preloading or duplicating that history into the handoff.

guards.description: Handoff tests enforce bounded bootstrap and live-head delta semantics.
Cold project history is retrieved on demand through owner/invariant/origin routing instead of becoming default context.
Every fresh Agent receives the bounded historical-recall trigger without preloading old history.

non_goals: Maintaining a second continuously rewritten summary of all project history.
Transporting live PostgreSQL as session authority.
purpose: Own bounded fresh-agent recovery of mission/current horizon/live cursor plus resume-relevant binary identity, and route into cold project history only when a relevant cue appears; live Git/CI and original repository history remain authority.
revisit_when: Only replace if a stronger continuity authority preserves bounded cold-start recovery, live-ref freshness, explicit asset integrity and selective historical recall without requiring user restatement or preloading project history.
title: Repository-backed session continuity and data-plane handoff
